en_us.tile.rbmk_boiler.name: RBMK Steam Channel
en_us.tile.rbmk_loader.name: RBMK Steam Connector
en_us.tile.rbmk_loader.desc: Allows RBMKs to have both water and steam connections at the bottom$Place one water pipe below the RBMK column, then the connector,$then connect the steam duct to the connector.
en_us.tile.rbmk_steam_inlet.name: RBMK ReaSim Water Inlet
en_us.tile.rbmk_steam_inlet.desc: Inserts water into RBMK columns if ReaSim boilers are enabled$Connects to RBMK columns sideways
en_us.tile.rbmk_steam_outlet.name: RBMK ReaSim Steam Outlet
en_us.tile.rbmk_steam_outlet.desc: Extracts super dense steam from RBMK columns if ReaSim boilers are enabled$Connects to RBMK columns sideways

zh_cn.container.rbmkBoiler: RBMK石墨式反应堆蒸汽管道
zh_cn.tile.rbmk_boiler.name: RBMK反应堆蒸汽管道
zh_cn.tile.rbmk_loader.name: RBMK反应堆蒸汽导出器
zh_cn.tile.rbmk_loader.desc: 让RBMK反应堆在底部同时拥有水接口和蒸汽接口$在RBMK蒸汽管道下方放置水管道，再在下面放置蒸汽导出器$最后将管道连接至蒸汽导出器即可
zh_cn.tile.rbmk_steam_inlet.name: RBMK ReaSim进水口
zh_cn.tile.rbmk_steam_inlet.desc: 当启用ReaSim锅炉时向反应堆内输入水$从侧面连接至反应堆结构
zh_cn.tile.rbmk_steam_outlet.name: RBMK ReaSim蒸汽出口
zh_cn.tile.rbmk_steam_outlet.desc: 当启用ReaSim锅炉时从反应堆内输出超热蒸汽$从侧面连接至反应堆结构
